name: Tuvalu
headline: Tuvalu: +5.2% growth in 2025, 2.9% inflation, debt 3% of GDP
sections: Tuvalu is a $70 million economy (2025), the world's 215th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +5.2% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $6,759 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K.
Consumer prices rose 2.9% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 12.1% in 2022.
Gross government debt is 3% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 12% in 2020. The general government balance is +25.8% of GDP (2025), a surplus.
The current account balance is +21.1% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Net FDI inflows were 0.4% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 3% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 67.3 years (2024). Population: 10 thousand (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
